host_checks.python_syntax: All Python helpers and the check tool
host_checks.boundary: Mocked host tests do not certify guest Apple frameworks

native_protocol.target: Disposable clones of the published automation-ready snapshots
native_protocol.input: Read-only host share copied into guest-local storage
native_protocol.output: Writable artifact share; build and result databases remain guest-local until export
native_protocol.fixture: Dependency-free SwiftUI macOS app with one XCTest
evidence: Guest command logs and real completion status
Guest readiness and automation guard restoration reports
native_protocol.cold_readiness_timing_definition: Readiness script wall time after the safe runner establishes guest exec; excludes boot
native_protocol.timing_definition: xcresult summary finishTime minus startTime; not total boot/build duration

environments.repair: Clear stale suspended metadata in the prepared snapshot; no guest disk repair needed
Replace selection of the incompatible brewed interpreter with a signed compatible framework distribution; configure both login shells and install its certificate bundle
observations: Additional cold checks exceeded the default 30-second guest deadline and initially misreported installed tools as missing; required checks now send explicit guest deadlines, require tool output, and retain request diagnostics
limitations: The cached macOS 26.7.1 installer did not upgrade this guest; the verified OS remains 26.2
The unlinked Homebrew Python 3.14.4 framework remains as an existing dependency and is not certified; its expat compatibility failure is not repaired in place

environments.repair: Select the functional versioned Python in existing zsh and bash login profiles instead of Xcode Python 3.9
observations: Additional cold readiness probes returned no Automation Mode/Xcode status with the default deadline; required checks now send explicit guest deadlines and retain failed-request diagnostics

environments.repair: Select versioned Python in the existing account's zsh and bash login profiles; preserve its original profile
limitations: A recurring personal Apple Account reminder leaves one UserNotificationCenter window; native app interaction passed but unattended prompt readiness did not
Account/profile provisioning experiments and temporary SSH changes were discarded before the scoped Python repair; no new account is part of the published snapshot
Saved-memory compatibility between GhostVM releases was not tested

native_regression.scenario: Successful detached guest launch with its transport acknowledgement replaced by curl status 28

preservation.verification: SHA256 for small files including configs and auxiliary storage; size, modification time, and inode for current disk and saved-memory files; unrelated snapshots compared against the baseline
preservation.published_resources_and_persistent_share: Preserved from each original prepared snapshot
preservation.owned_guests: Stopped and temporary automation configuration restored

reusable_cache.verification: Source and cache copy matched; surrounding Restore metadata and firmware preserved
Official release checksum, trusted package signature, and cache copy checksum matched

scope_limits: This verifies GhostVM transport, snapshot maintenance, functional Python, and one macOS UI interaction, not every application or simulator runtime
Rosetta is optional and was not required for these arm64 checks
A screenshot attachment and a valid result bundle are not claims of visual inspection
An unrelated account alert is retained as a failed prerequisite, not reclassified as a successful unattended check
